name: Imaginary Friend
description: He likes small spaces...

name: The Neighbour
description: She's always lonely

name: Factory Foreman
description: What's in those barrels?

name: Schoolyard Bully
description: His words are as hard as his fists

name: Lunch Lady
description: She has the best toys...

name: Grief Counsellor
description: Accidents are accidents.

name: Bottle Shop Attendant
description: Enabler of liquid escapes and forgotten promises.

name: Graduation Twins
description: Two faces of achievement - pride and disappointment intertwined.

name: Headmaster Baird
description: He saw your pride, he smelled her shame...

name: Nervous Intern
description: Your younger, anxious self reflected in corporate fluorescent lights.

name: Paranoid Colleague
description: Workplace sabotage fears made manifest in corporate paranoia.

name: VP Calhoun
description: The authority you're trying to impress, holding your career in their hands.

name: The Doula
description: Judged you from day one, who does the think is paying her?

name: Babysitter
description: Great with the kid, but too friendly...

name: Micro Manager
description: If anyone is to blame its him.

name: Strange Man
description: Claims to be a cousin. False family connections emerge at funerals.

name: Mortician
description: Professional handler of death, witness to your family's final dysfunction.

name: Pastor
description: Moral judgment incarnate, with a fixed cross necklace that never quite sits right.

name: The Replacement
description: Your successor, younger and eager, everything you once were.

name: The CEO
description: Corporate hierarchy's peak, representing the career that consumed your life.

name: Divorce Lawyer
description: Legal dissolution of a marriage that was already emotionally dead.

name: Toll Booth Operator
description: Gatekeeper on the journey to reconciliation, demanding payment for passage.

name: Motel Clerk
description: Witness to your lonely journey, keeper of temporary refuges.

name: Dad's Reflection
description: Confronting inherited patterns, the ghost of generational dysfunction.

name: Photographer
description: Curator of false memories, capturing only what should be remembered.

name: Dark Room Assistant
description: Developer of hidden truths, bringing painful memories into focus.

name: The Missing Figure
description: Absent memories made manifest, the gaps in your curated history.

name: Cruel Nurse
description: Indifferent to suffering, a reminder of institutional coldness in final moments.

name: Dr. Keller
description: Medical authority presiding over your final transition, clinical and detached.

name: The Player
description: Final self-confrontation. You are your own greatest enemy and salvation. Mirrors your exact current state.

name: The Waiting Son
description: He waits by the door, holding the weight you left behind.

name: The Unspoken Witness
description: They carry the words you never said.

name: The Forgiver
description: They offer forgiveness with no conditions.

name: The Questioner
description: A voice asks from the other side, and you still hesitate.

name: The Confessor
description: They speak in the dark, but the voice is not yours.

name: The Weeping Stranger
description: On the stairs, a stranger with your face passes by—crying—without ever seeing you.

name: The Pursuer
description: You run, and they still follow.

name: The Accusor
description: He kneels and begs, and your answer is the blade.

name: The Inheritor
description: He answers: you did not break it. You buried it.

name: The Radio Host
description: He plays Dad’s favourite song like it can change what happened.

name: The Mechanic
description: No explanation ever arrived, only the ticking.

name: The Hero
description: He insists you could have lifted it all—if only you’d been stronger.

name: The Starless Witness
description: Only your heartbeat remains, and Mum's last goodbye.

name: The Promise-Giver
description: They promise peace, but the light feels wrong.

name: The Truthbearer
description: Each shard whispers the truth you buried.

name: The Varnish Prince
description: In the trunk’s pitch-black air it clings to your lungs... Varnish, dust, and counted heartbeats.

name: The Lady in the Wardrobe
description: Close air smells of stale perfume and decay, coaxing you to stay perfectly still.

name: Mother
description: 30 minutes of oxygen, 4 hours of drinking, a lifetime to remember.

name: The Hall Monitor
description: He'll be someone one day, then they'll see...

name: The Quiet Nurse
description: She delights in watching you read the note you still don't understand.

name: The Groundskeeper
description: Always watching the children, but never watching over them.
